newsitem.title: UK: Tradepoint secures long term financing.
newsitem.headline: Tradepoint secures long term financing.

text.p: The TradePoint Investment Exchange, the main rival to the London Stock Exchange, said on Monday that it has secured long term financing of around 11.4 million stg.
The investors providing the long term financing have subscribed for 12 million stg zero coupon convertible bond, which is convertible into new ordinary shares at a price of 40p per share.

A further 30 million new ordinary shares will be issued, representing 58.47 percent of the company's fully diluted share capital, once the financing is complete and assuming full conversion of the loan stock.

This would leave Apax Partners with 29.24 percent of Tradepoint's share capital. Electra Fleming will own 7.31, Smedvig 1.22 percent. Tullett and Tokyo Forex International Ltd 4.87 percent, United Broking Ltd 4.87 percent and First Equity Holdings Ltd 2.44 percent.
Tradepoint is owned by Tradepoint Financial Networks Plc and offers investors a facility to buy and sell shares electronically in more than 900 British companies.
The company's shares, which are traded on the Alternative Investment Market (AIM), were restored to trading following the announcement. By 1548 GMT, Tradepoint shares were quoted 5p lower at 65p.
